248202|055d4e51.name: Jim'bek
248202|055d4e51.text:
<Jim'bek locks eyes with you as he takes a deep puff from his hookah.>

'Ello, mon. Need a rug? A blanket? Or just some cloth for your next project? I got you.

256386|6a190ff9.name: Dokimi
256386|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256388|13e9970d.name: Jornah
256388|13e9970d.text:
Greetings and well met, $N! Your arrival is timely, and we here at the Durotar Supply and Logistics company are always in need of new contractors.

If you are someone with a knack for gathering useful materials or the skills to craft something from scratch, you have a place here.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

256388|6df3de7b.name: Jornah
256388|6df3de7b.text:
Yes! Well. Sort of.

Gold is the true universal currency, but we have our own system for trade amongst ourselves known as Merchant's Favor. It abstracts away the ever-fluctuating value of gold and silver, and ensures fair and equitable trade between members of the organization. It cannot be liquidated to gold, unless you're engaging in some shady activity, I suppose.

We still use gold for typical day-to-day needs such as materials needed for common crafts, but otherwise rely on Merchant's Favor for any kind of internal commerce.

If you assist us with recovering waylaid crates and ensuring swift fulfillment of craftsman's writs, you will earn plenty!

2855|8f48a40a.name: Snang
2855|8f48a40a.text: I know a few things, but I'm no expert. Lucky for you, Magar is. He's standing near the back of the shop. See if he can help you, but be careful not to rile him. He can be irritable.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3325|031480cd.name: Mirket
3325|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3363|05c29513.name: Magar
3363|05c29513.text: About time you showed me some results! Now I'll show you results!

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

1058-accept.name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
1058-accept.text:
So excited I am!

Three little cages for three little elves! But what shall we do with our lovely tree-hugging friends? Why, let's give them a taste of... what do they call it... forest magic!

I'll need a good mess of Stonetalon sap. From those horrid felines, bring me some twilight whiskers. This calls for plenty of courser eyes, of course -- can never have enough eyes. Oh, and lest we forget, a precious scale from a fey dragon.

Hurry to Stonetalon Peak, $N, so I can brew some forest magic!
1058-accept.title: Jin'Zil's Forest Magic

1510-complete.name: Ken'zigla
1510-complete.text:
Another orc, eh? I hope you haven't come for the other. He didn't make it. Those goblins did him in good.

He said he needed a healing draught, but not much else.
1510-complete.title: News of Dogran

1511-accept.name: Ken'zigla
1511-accept.text:
I figured there might be another coming to get the draught, so I prepared it anyways.

Here you go, $N. Mind you, you should only give half of it to him! That will give him enough strength to move without bleeding himself dry. Wait a night, then give him the other half.

Anyways, you'll want to bring this to Logmar at Camp Taurajo. From what the first one told me, he should have an idea where this Dogran is.
1511-accept.title: Ken'zigla's Draught

91904-progress.name: Dokimi
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate
